title: SLAS – ELRIG Joint meet-up 2026
content: SLAS – ELRIG Joint meet-up 2026 by Gayshini | Dec 9, 2025 SLAS – ELRIG Joint networking event Date 09 December 2026 Location UK – TBC Day(s) : Hour(s) : Minute(s) : Second(s) Find out more Save the date! Please save the date for the joint SLAS and ELRIG December Meet-Up! This event brings both communities together for a day of scientific discussion and networking. This free-to-attend event is an excellent opportunity to wrap up a successful year connecting with other scientists, students and entrepreneurs. More details coming soon!
